baseline.later_root_commit_context_only: 97b54464f6ebf8540cbce8d5df382ad652f963d4; 233 decisions. This does not relabel the initial baseline.

recommendation: Retain qualified preclinical mitochondrial/morphology context for existing NR. No new demonstrated treated strength/endurance benefit or independent functional-priority upgrade.
decisive_limit: Figure5 respiratory analyses are genotype comparisons within untreated and NR-treated groups, separately normalized to their respective WT. No direct NR-versus-untreated NEM6 effect, genotype-by-treatment interaction or common absolute-scale treatment estimate/CI supplied. Authors acknowledge lack of placebo-controlled mice.

intervention.received_exposure_limit: Actual individual water consumption, adherence, weight-based adjustment, systemic exposure and chloride/free-riboside dose conversion not reported. Group housed with ad-libitum water/food.
intervention.timing: Before observed mitochondrial phenotype, not reversal after established disease or an off-treatment durability experiment.
intervention.source_naming: Methods once says nicotinamide ribose, but defined NR and reagent identity specify riboside chloride.

model.disease_context: NEM6; human founder variant described as autosomal dominant. Not BUB1B/MVA.
model.controls: NR-treated WT and NEM6 are compared with untreated natural-history groups; authors explicitly state no placebo-controlled mice.
model.total_treated_animal_flow: Not supplied; endpoint sample sets cannot be summed as distinct animals.

severely_damaged_mitochondria.credit: Marked observed morphological difference; individual mitochondria are nested within animals.
severely_damaged_mitochondria.limit: Generic microscopy count ranges cannot be imposed on the treated group or treated as independent animals.

core_affected_fibers.result: No prevention of core phenotype demonstrated.

protein_abundance.normalization: Total protein; fold change to untreated NEM6.
protein_abundance.interpretation: Selected complexIII/V protein increases; no detected TOM20 increase. Unmatched sex composition and absent placebo allocation constrain treatment attribution. No BUBR1 assay.

treatment_observations.residual_structure: Z-line discontinuities still visible in treated electron micrographs.
treatment_observations.treated_grip_or_force: Not reported, not an observed null.
treatment_observations.treated_treadmill_or_endurance: Not reported, not an observed null.
treatment_observations.treated_clinical_motor_outcome: Not reported; no human NR intervention in this study.

respiration.method: High-resolution ex-vivo respiration in permeabilized soleus bundles, normalized to wet sample mass before fold-change presentation.
respiration.display: Untreated normalized to untreated WT; treated normalized to NR-treated WT.
respiration.endpoint_n_sex: Not explicitly given in main treatment legend or essential supplement; no animal n inferred from point symbols.
respiration.interpretation: No detected genotype gap after treatment is compatible with prevention, but does not establish a significant NR effect or equivalence to WT. The untreated NADH-linked comparison was already nonsignificant.

natural_history_separate.untreated_respiration: No detected soleus OXPHOS genotype deficit at1month; deficit at3,9,18months. EDL respiratory comparisons at older ages are nonsignificant.
natural_history_separate.untreated_treadmill: No detected3-4month genotype impairment; later8-9month metabolic/running and18-20month running impairments. No NR-treated treadmill test at these ages.
natural_history_separate.limit: Natural-history muscle weakness may also influence treadmill results; mitochondrial causality is not isolated.

NAD_mechanism.pre_treatment_rationale: Untreated metabolomics authors report lower NAD+ at3 and9months; no exact NAD-specific treatment effect or FDR supplied in the text.
not_established: NAD deficit in four-week-old treatment-start animals
NAD restoration mediating the observed changes
NAD_mechanism.staining_limit: NADH histoenzymatic staining is not direct endogenous NAD+ pool quantification.
NAD_mechanism.tryptophan_limit: Lower abundance is not direct proof of impaired de-novo flux.

acute_NAD_experiment.intervention: 10µM NAD+ added ex vivo, distinct from chronic NR
acute_NAD_experiment.interpretation: Restricted acute assay null; no broad inference about every NAD-directed therapy.

harms: No systematic treatment-arm adverse-event, mortality, organ toxicity, cancer or long-term assessment. Cited general tolerability is not safety evidence from this experiment.

essential_counterevidence.scope: Complete exact primary abstract and metadata only; no full main.
essential_counterevidence.NR_result: Dystrophin-deficient MDX model under repeated eccentric challenge: NR did not significantly change molecular phenotype, sustainably increase bulk NAD, lessen injury markers or improve maximal hindlimb strength.
essential_counterevidence.CD38_separate: Separate inhibitor altered metabolites more extensively without functional protection; do not assign those molecular results to NR.
essential_counterevidence.limit: Context-specific actual NR functional null; not all-congenital-myopathy inefficacy and not negation of NEM6 morphology observations.

competition: Useful actual-compound preclinical morphology/organelle-function context, without adding a demonstrated NR-treated strength/endurance result. Does not replace the distinct NICE human walking signal or establish superiority over niacin/apitegromab. No selective MVA-proof bar, no quantitative cross-trial ranking.
